title: Case Study: TerramEarth — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Cellular Blackout & Massive Post-Outage Ingestion Surge: 50,000 tractors reconnect simultaneously after a regional cellular outage.
routing_rationale: Buffer-based streaming architecture (Pub/Sub + Dataflow) absorbs massive reconnection surges without dropping telemetry or crashing analytics backends.

nodes.label: Accumulated Telemetry Surge
nodes.detail: Tractors re-establish cellular link and dump buffered local memory simultaneously.

nodes.label: Pub/Sub Elastic Partition Buffer
nodes.detail: Pub/Sub scales dynamically without provisioned partition limits, buffering messages safely.

nodes.label: Dataflow Autoscaling Workers
nodes.detail: Autoscaler monitors Pub/Sub backlog age and spins up 64 workers within 3 minutes.

nodes.label: Bigtable Writes Sustained
nodes.detail: Bigtable absorbs 250,000 writes/sec with zero dropped packets and no hotspotting.

steps.title: Surge Decoupling & Buffering
steps.action: Pub/Sub absorbs 20x traffic surge without backpressure; Dataflow scales up worker nodes.
steps.why_traversal: Decouples unpredictable vehicle reconnection bursts from processing capacity.

steps.title: Parallel Backlog Processing
steps.action: 64 Dataflow workers drain backlog in 18 minutes, writing orderly time-series into Bigtable.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees zero data loss while maintaining real-time processing SLAs.

scenarios.label: Direct Database Write Anti-Pattern Meltdown
scenarios.root_cause: System attempted to write tractor telemetry directly to database without Pub/Sub buffer.
scenarios.diverted_path: 50,000 simultaneous connections exhausted DB connection pool; 80% of packets lost.
scenarios.blast_radius: Permanent loss of critical field sensor data.
scenarios.recovery: Never connect external IoT devices directly to databases; always place Cloud Pub/Sub at ingress.
